verdicts.title: Heun's equation, generalized hypergeometric function and exceptional Jacobi polynomial
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study Heun's differential equation in the case that one of the singularities is apparent. In particular we conjecture a relationship with generalized hypergeometric differential equation and establish it in some cases. We apply our results to exceptional Jacobi polynomials.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Heun's equation, generalized hypergeometric differential equations, and exceptional Jacobi polynomials, but makes no mention of XOR-AND tree width, complexity theory, or rank bounds of solutions in terms of tree leaves. It shares only the 'generalized hypergeometric' vocabulary without addressing the specific complexity-theoretic claim.
